  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  APRIL 14, 2020

  An Emergency meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor McKeown at 7:47
  p.m., on Tuesday, April 14, 2020, via teleconference pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 at
  https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/ptrewcrr

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Kevin McKeown
  Mayor Pro Tem Terry O’Day
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Ana M. Jara
  Councilmember Greg Morena
  Councilmember Ted Winterer

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 7:47 p.m., with all
  members present.

  REORDER AGENDA  Due to the meeting start time being so late, and with consideration that the
  Closed Session would go long, Council gave consideration to hear the
  remainder of the agenda before the Closed Session.

  Motion by Councilmember Jara, seconded by Councilmember Himmelrich,
  to reorder the agenda and hear Items 11.A, 11.B and 14 before the Closed
  Session. The motion was approved by voice vote, with all members
  present.

  RESOLUTIONS:  11.A Adoption of Resolution No. 11242 (CCS) entitled “AN
  COVID-19 EMERGENCY  EMERGENCY RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF SANTA MONICA
  PROCLAMATION  PURSUANT TO CHAPTER 2.16 OF THE SANTA MONICA
  MUNICIPAL CODE RATIFYING THE PROCLAMATION OF
  EXISTENCE OF LOCAL EMERGENCY AND SUPPLEMENTAL
  PROCLAMATIONS THERETO”, was presented.

  Recommended Action
  Staff recommends that Council adopt Attached Resolution No. 11242
  (CCS) ratifying and extending to May 15, 2020, the Executive Order issued

  1  April 14, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 2601B163-5C66-4CEF-B000-789C2F80CE06

  by the Director of Emergency Services declaring the existence of a local
  emergency in the City of Santa Monica, and the Supplements to that Order.

  There were no members of the public present to speak on this item.

  The City Attorney amended the Resolution to add new Section 17
  extending the Executive Order remain in affect until the date to May 30,
  2020, unless otherwise stated in an individual supplement.

  Councilmember Morena recused himself for Supplement 6, because his
  Councilmember Morena  family owns a business on the Pier, and to avoid any appearance of a
  excused at 8:04 p.m.  conflict of interest, he recused himself.

  Motion by Councilmember Winterer, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem O’Day,
  to approve the Emergency Orders that pertain to the Pier, Supplements #2
  and #6. The motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Jara, Winterer, Davis, Himmelrich,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: Councilmember Morena

  Councilmember Morena  Motion by Councilmember Morena, seconded by Councilmember Jara, to
  returned at 8:06 p.m.  adopt the remainder of Resolution No. 11242 (CCS), ratifying and
  extending the Executive Order to May 30, 2020, the Executive issue by the
  Director of Emergency Services declaring the existence of a local
  emergency in the City of Santa Monica, reading by title only and waiving
  further reading thereof. The motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Morena, Himmelrich, Davis, Winterer, Jara,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  DESIGNATED  11.B. Adopt Resolution No. 11243 (CCS) entitled “A RESOLUTION
  REPRESENTATIVES  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SANTA MONICA
  DESIGNATING AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVES TO ACT ON
  BEHALF OF THE CITY OF SANTA MONICA TO APPLY FOR STATE
  OR FEDERAL DISASTER RELIEF FUNDING RELATING TOCOVID-
  19 AND TO APPLY FOR STATE, FEDERAL OR PRIVATE GRANTS
  SUPPORTING COVID-19 RELIEF”, was presented.

  Recommended Action
  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  1) Adopt the attached resolution to designate representatives
  authorized to execute grant documents on behalf of the City of

  2  April 14, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 2601B163-5C66-4CEF-B000-789C2F80CE06

  Santa Monica with the California Office of Emergency Services and
  Federal Emergency Management Agency, ratify the City Manager’s
  delegation of authority to pursue other COVID-19 related grants,
  and provide authority to adjust the budget to reflect any grants
  obtained; and
  2) Approve and authorize the execution of the CalOES Form 130
  provided by the California Office of Emergency Services.

  There were no members of the public present to speak on this item.

  Motion by Councilmember Winterer, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem O’Day,
  to adopt Resolution No. 11243 (CCS), reading by title only and waiving
  further reading thereof. The motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Jara, Winterer, Davis, Himmelrich, Morena,
  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  PUBLIC INPUT:  There were no members of the public present to comment on various local
  issues.

  Comments from the Coalition of Santa Monica City Employees was read
  CLOSED SESSIONS  into the public record on closed sessions.

  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 8:15 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 11:26 p.m., with all members present, to
  report the following:

  1.A Conference with Labor Negotiator: Government Code Section
  54957.6.
  Agency Designated Representatives: Chief People Officer Lori Gentles,
  Human Resources Manager Shawn Weiske, and Laura Kalty, Outside
  Counsel, Liebert Cassidy Whitmore

  Bargaining Units: Administrative Team Associates, California
  Teamsters Local 911, Confidential Unrepresented Employees Pay
  Plan, Executive Pay Plan, Municipal Employees Association,
  Management Team Associates, Public Attorneys Legal Support Staff
  Union, Public Attorneys Union, Santa Monica Fire Executive
  Management Association, Santa Monica Firefighters Local 1109 IAFF,
  Santa Monica Police Officers Association, Supervisory Team
  Associates, International Association of Sheet Metal, Air, Rail, and
  Transportation Workers, Transportation Division Local 1785
  (SMART TD). Unrepresented Employees: City Attorney; Special
  Counsel / Chief of Staff, City Attorney’s Office; Office Administrator,

  3  April 14, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 2601B163-5C66-4CEF-B000-789C2F80CE06

  City Attorney’s Office; Executive Assistant to the City Attorney, City
  Attorney’s Office; City Clerk; City Manager; Assistant City Manager;
  Deputy City Manager; Executive Administrator, City Manager’s
  Office; Council Office Coordinator, City Manager’s Office;
  Communications and Public Affairs Officer, City Manager’s Office;
  Assistant to the City Manager, City Manager’s Office; Administrative
  Assistant, City Manager’s Office.

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 11:27 p.m.
